description: This file defines the Error class in Twig's error handling module, serving as the base exception class for template-related errors such as syntax errors or loading issues. It tracks source information like template name and line number to aid debugging.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Base exception class for Twig template errors, capturing context like source path, name, line number, and message, with methods to manage error details and assist debugging.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Error object with message, line number, source context, and previous exception.

methods.name: getTemplateLine
methods.description: Returns the line number where the error occurred in the template.

methods.name: setTemplateLine
methods.description: Sets the line number where the error occurred.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Returns the Source object representing the template source context.

methods.name: setSourceContext
methods.description: Resets source-related information with a new Source object or clears it.

methods.name: guess
methods.description: Attempts to automatically guess template info such as name and line number.

methods.name: appendMessage
methods.description: Appends additional information to the error message.

methods.name: updateRepr
methods.description: Updates the string representation of the exception, including message, source details, and line number.

methods.name: guessTemplateInfo
methods.description: Guesses and sets template name and line number by inspecting the call stack and template debug info.
